name: quick_draw_katana_nothing_on_opponents_turn
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'During your turn, equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has first strike.' Seat 0 equips Your Bear (2/2) on its turn. On seat 1's turn the bonus is gone: Opp Ape (3/3) attacks, the Bear (2/2 again, no first strike) blocks; the Ape deals 3 and the Bear dies, the Bear deals 2 to the Ape at the same time.
